children: Indonesia plans to start trading at its new commodity exchange on January 4, 2027, with tin and ferronickel to be included in the opening transactions, chief supervisor of the commodity exchange Sarjito said on Tuesday.
State miners are expected to be among the first participants in the exchange, Sarjito said.
